findings.label: Unauthenticated job-status endpoint
findings.description: GET /transcripts/job/:jobId has no authenticateUser middleware. All other routes in the file require it. Add the middleware; the mobile client already sends the bearer token in poll requests.

findings.label: Retry progress frozen at 40%
findings.description: transcriptionService.ts updates the job message per retry attempt but never updates progress, so the bar stays at 40% for the entire Gemini call including multi-model retries. Pass progress increments (e.g. 40→50→60→70) per attempt.

findings.label: Silent success on missing jobId
findings.description: If the server returns 2xx without a jobId field, neither the fetch nor XHR path shows the user an alert. The spinner clears correctly but the user receives no confirmation. Add a fallback alert for the no-jobId case.
